description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView component that implements the LogNode interface to display log data in a user interface. It provides methods for formatting and forwarding log messages within an Android application.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that implements LogNode to display log messages and errors in a scrollable text view within an Android activity.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays a log message, including optional exception details, in the LogView. Also forwards the message to the next LogNode if configured.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which log messages are forwarded.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView display.
